decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 6 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 18 made more than one change of direction to defend its position
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 18 made multiple moves in defending against Car 55 on the straight before turn 9. This is a breach of the regulations.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 18 More Than One Change Of Direction
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
